Travel notice for companion animal travelers

Please review the guidance below before you arrive at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Our team helps travelers prepare companion animal papers, check crate fit, and plan for a calm trip. The senior coordinator keeps daily service choices on track, and the safety coordinator looks for hazards and simple ways to prevent them. <<FACT F116>> If a traveler needs support after an incident, the desk can explain the next steps and keep the process steady. <<FACT F113>>

We also remind travelers to keep leashes, carriers, and comfort items ready before check-in. If Luna or another pet needs extra space, please tell the desk early so we can guide you with care and avoid last-minute stress.

For help with companion animal travel, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
